## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden. She is also fair and possesses golden hair.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is a pale and spiritual-looking young woman. Despite her serene appearance, she is full of mischief, fun, and a love for pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- full of mischief and pranks and fun  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for a spring picnic walk where they explored the woods, discovered Hester Gray's forgotten garden, and shared their poetic thoughts on nature. Priscilla later sent a letter explaining that author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) had sprained her ankle, delaying a planned visit, but eventually brought Mrs.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), +11 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla is one of Anne's intimate academy friends from their time studying at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Their bond continues past their school days through social outings, such as joining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for a spring picnic walk to explore the woods and Hester Gray's garden. Priscilla also coordinates visits to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), writing to explain an initial delay when Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprains her ankle and later bringing the author to visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unannounced.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +23 more_

- Friend of — intimate academy friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +4 more</sub>

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-andrews--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) are mutual friends who spend time socializing together. Their shared activities include going on a picnic walk through the woods alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate Anne's spring birthday, where they explore the outdoors and converse about nature and Hester Gray's garden.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), +5 more_

- Friend of — friends who go on picnics together (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003)</sub>

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is Priscilla's aunt, and the two travel and visit places together. Priscilla acts as an intermediary for her aunt's social calls, sending a letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprains her ankle and later accompanying the famous author on an unexpected visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), +9 more_
